_comment: All human-facing frame copy for the FREE variant. Edit wording here — render-comment.mjs only selects and fills {{PLACEHOLDER}}s. The agent authors the report BODY itself; this file owns only the harness-controlled frame.

live_bug.headline: Bug reproduced — present on the reported version and on trunk

fixed_on_trunk.headline: Bug reproduced on the reported version — already fixed on trunk

regression.headline: Regression — fine on the reported version, broken on trunk
regression.callout:
> [!WARNING]
> Confirm the reported leg actually exercised the symptom — a missing fixture can fake a regression.

not_reproducible.headline: Could not reproduce the bug
not_reproducible.callout:
> [!NOTE]
> The symptom was observed on NEITHER version, including the reported (buggy) one — most often the repro doesn't faithfully hit the scenario. Confirm before closing.

needs_human_review.headline: Needs human review
needs_human_review.callout:
> [!CAUTION]
> Treat as unconfirmed — a human should verify the reproduction faithfully matches the report before acting.

phrases.undisclosed_intro: **Undisclosed changes** — the agent modified these files without referencing them in its report:
phrases.shop_edits_intro: **The agent edited the provisioned shop's own code.** The reported leg ran against a modified shop, so this run needs a human judgement:
phrases.inconsistency_intro: **Inconsistent signals from run.sh** — the exit code and the `##repro` markers disagree:
phrases.footer: 🤖 The narrative above was written by the reproduction agent. Every code block, run output, and image was inserted by the harness from the trusted runs — the agent cannot author those, only reference them. The verdict is computed deterministically from the two legs.
phrases.incomplete_reason_default: The agent did not produce a runnable reproduction bundle.
